trust_decision.summary: Whether an unauthenticated POST to plugin/AuthorizeNet/webhook.php really came from Authorize.Net (HMAC-SHA512 over the raw body keyed with the configured Signature Key), and whether the users_id / amount / currency / plans_id / isApproved that get credited to the wallet come from Authorize.Net's API rather than from the request body; decided in AuthorizeNet::verifySignature + parseWebhookRequest (AuthorizeNet.php:51-128), gated in webhook.php:9-38 and 44-58, with the wallet credit sink at AuthorizeNet.php:283.

landing_point.why: The summary names a webhook signature bypass, so the first grep lands in webhook.php; line 32-33 literally reads 'Block only if both invalid signature AND no valid txn info', which is the bypass, and the adjacent call at webhook.php:10 leads straight to AuthorizeNet::verifySignature.

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /plugin/AuthorizeNet/webhook.php (unauthenticated public webhook; same-domain check disabled at webhook.php:4)
public static AuthorizeNet::verifySignature() (public class API, called from parseWebhookRequest at AuthorizeNet.php:90)
public static AuthorizeNet::parseWebhookRequest() (public class API used by the webhook handler)
GET/POST /plugin/AuthorizeNet/registerWebhook.json.php (new admin-only endpoint added by the fix; additive, not part of the bypass)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: plugin/AuthorizeNet/AuthorizeNet.php:253-298 (AuthorizeNet::processSinglePayment; also reachable via processSubscriptionCharge at AuthorizeNet.php:312-354 and processSubscriptionChargeWithPlan at AuthorizeNet.php:365-413)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: processSinglePayment is an internal library function with no HTTP route of its own; the advisory is about the public webhook handler, so a solver can argue the API is only reached by trusted plugin code after the webhook check, even though it credits any caller-supplied users_id/amount straight to YPTWallet::addBalance (AuthorizeNet.php:283) and was left untouched by the fix.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The fix's new gate 'if (empty($analysis['isApproved'])) exit' (fix.diff:253-262) consumes $txnInfo['isApproved'] produced by getTransactionDetails, whose comparison is case-sensitive against the camelCase constants 'capturedPendingSettlement'/'settledSuccessfully' (AuthorizeNet.php:1027) while the sibling analyzer already lowercases (AuthorizeNet.php:224-225); the published fix had to change exactly that line (fix.diff:110), so a solver who adds the approval gate without fixing the producer rejects every genuine payment. Likewise the legitimate duplicate-delivery path must keep returning HTTP 200 'duplicate' (webhook.php:22-27) and the payload->txnInfo fallbacks at webhook.php:44-58 must keep filling values the payload legitimately lacks (e.g. plans_id only present on the ARB order description).

O6_input_shapes: Signature header value in lowercase vs uppercase hex (fix lowercases the received header before hash_equals, fix.diff:38-39)
Signature key treated as raw ASCII vs hex-decoded bytes (old hex2bin + ctype_xdigit guard at AuthorizeNet.php:54-57 removed, fix.diff:26-32)
Missing / empty Signature Key or missing signature header (rejected outright instead of being ignored)
Body amount supplied as 'amount' or 'authAmount' vs the API's getAuthAmount (AuthorizeNet.php:109, 171)
Body metadata.users_id / metadata.plans_id vs the users_id/plans_id decoded from the ARB order description (AuthorizeNet.php:169-170, 188-213, 1054-1055)
Body responseCode as approval evidence vs the API transaction status string, including its casing (AuthorizeNet.php:226-227 vs 1027)
Transaction id supplied under payload.id or payload.transId (AuthorizeNet.php:108)

O7_producer.where: plugin/Plugin.abstract.php:193-245 - PluginAbstract::getDataObject() reads plugins.object_data from the DB, merges it with getEmptyDataObject() defaults and type-coerces each key (Plugin.abstract.php:204-223); the AuthorizeNet default is signatureKey = '' (plugin/AuthorizeNet/AuthorizeNet.php:1257) and the protected check consumes it at AuthorizeNet.php:90. A non-string (e.g. numeric) stored signatureKey is silently replaced by the empty default, which disables verification entirely rather than failing loudly.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /plugin/AuthorizeNet/processPayment.json.php for any logged-in user credits YPTWallet with a client-supplied 'amount' and a hard-coded $paymentSuccess = true, without any webhook, signature, or gateway call
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is not a webhook at all - no signature header is involved, the file is marked '// TODO: Implement payment logic' and '// Simulate payment success for now', and nothing in the plugin references it, so a solver reading a report about webhook signature verification has a plausible reason to call it an unfinished neighbour and leave it.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same plugin directory, 1 file from the landing point; an authenticated-user route (User::getId() at processPayment.json.php:19) rather than an unauthenticated one

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A YPTWalletAuthorizeNet gateway folder (requestPayment.json.php / redirect_url.php) that credits the wallet on the browser return from the Accept Hosted page
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Every other YPTWallet gateway already has such a folder and credits from the return leg (StripeYPT here, RazorPay at plugin/YPTWallet/plugins/YPTWalletRazorPay/redirect_url.php:72), and AuthorizeNet already exposes a hosted payment page with acceptHostedReturn.php as its return URL, so a maintainer would copy the pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second webhook file for the other event types createWebhookIfNotExists can register (subscription charged, void, refund) that credits or reverses wallet balance
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The event list is already a parameter of createWebhookIfNotExists and updateWebhookEventTypes (AuthorizeNet.php:930), so adding siblings of net.authorize.payment.authcapture.created is a one-line change a maintainer would make without touching the existing handler.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A 'reprocess' action on a webhook-log row that calls AuthorizeNet::processSinglePayment with the stored payload
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Admins already hand-edit anet_webhook_log rows here (uniq_key, payload_json, processed), so a replay/reprocess button is the obvious next admin feature and would reach the same sink with no signature at all.

O9_family: insufficient verification of data authenticity / forged payment data (CWE-345), webhook signature bypass leading to wallet balance inflation

O10_build.toolchain: composer with vendor/ committed (vendor/authorizenet, vendor/aws, vendor/google present); phpunit 9.6 via phpunit.xml plus tests/bootstrap.php; web server + PHP extensions curl/json
services: MySQL/MariaDB (anet_webhook_log schema at plugin/AuthorizeNet/install/install.sql, plus the core AVideo schema)
Outbound HTTPS to api.authorize.net / apitest.authorize.net for getTransactionDetails and the webhook REST calls
O10_build.project_tests: tests/ has phpunit Security/Unit suites but no test mentions AuthorizeNet, webhook or verifySignature; the published fix adds no test files either, so this area has no tests at the pinned commit.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Repair the hex/ctype key handling in verifySignature (or the casing of the signature header) and add an early 401 in webhook.php, leaving the 'or a valid transaction exists' fallback, the payload-precedence rules and processPayment.json.php untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: Other payment plugins credit the same YPTWallet sink with their own verification (plugin/StripeYPT/ipn.php:83 -> StripeYPT.php:753-766, plugin/PayPalYPT/ipn.php:32, plugin/BTCPayments/webhook.php:90, plugin/BlockonomicsYPT/callback.php:62); outside this advisory's Authorize.Net property and not pursued.
unverified: Repo size in MB: no shell was available, so O4.repo_mb is null and tiny_repo/giant_repo were not asserted; the tree clearly contains a large committed vendor/ (google/apiclient-services, aws-sdk-php) plus media assets.
present_in_latest for the O8 route: the task states 'latest release: none', so there is no later tree to compare and it stays unknown.

Whether the live Authorize.Net API returns transaction status in a casing that the pinned getTransactionDetails comparison misses: inferred only from the fix itself having to add strtolower at fix.diff:110; not exercised.

needs_network_at_runtime: the signature gate itself is offline-testable through AuthorizeNet::verifySignature / parseWebhookRequest (no I/O), but the credit path and the txnInfo-precedence behaviour both require getTransactionDetails, a static call into the Authorize.Net SDK with no injection seam, so end-to-end credit assertions cannot run offline.
O8 route reachability was read, not run: processPayment.json.php requires a logged-in user (User::getId()) and is referenced by no other file in the tree.
